description: The FRST research team publishes paved and unpaved road classifications for 50 African countries or regions. The dataset combines OpenStreetMap roads with GDP, population distribution, building height and land cover. Figshare stores a separate compressed package for each country or region and applies CC-BY-4.0, allowing public, free reuse with attribution. The repository reports about 13,309 road entries and a total length of roughly 6.82 million kilometres; the apparent mismatch between these quantities needs clarification from the internal schema. Source dates and internal vector encoding were not established from the landing page. A limitation is that inferred surface classes and varying input completeness constrain local interpretation. The classifications could parameterise travel speeds, accessibility or flood-disruption sensitivity in road-network simulations after validation. FRST complements the source road geometry with a surface attribute. No archive was downloaded and the stated length was not recomputed.
